scenicChapters.title: Kyrgyzstan Issyk Kul Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 22 km this is Kyrgyzstan Issyk Kul Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

story: Out of Bishkek and back again: 664 km, roughly 10 h 43 in the saddle. It goes by way of Balykchy, Bokonbaevo, Jeti Oguz and Karakol. The highest point is about 3,300 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

slogan: Naryn to Kochkor · 117 km home again

scenicChapters.title: Naryn → Moldo Ashuu Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 116 km. 3346 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.

scenicChapters.title: Kyrgyzstan Song Kol Route
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 3346 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Kyrgyzstan Song Kol Route
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 10.9%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter. First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Kalmak Ashuu Pass → Kochkor
scenicChapters.narrative: Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace. 3447 m come off over 77 km at around 6.4%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it.

story: A one-way ride of 270 km, Naryn to Kochkor - roughly 3 h 48 in the saddle. The stops in between: Moldo Ashuu Pass, Song Kol and Kalmak Ashuu Pass. The highest point is about 3,450 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
